live.rule: One leg per live game: the highest-chance FanDuel PA in-play selection priced -1000 to +200. Chance = 50% FanDuel live no-vig price + 50% our score/clock model (pregame spread/total from ESPN, ESPN live win probability for NFL/NBA/college, Poisson goals for NHL/soccer). props.rule: Pregame only. One leg per player (his highest-chance line priced -1000 to +150), at most 2 legs per game in a parlay, each leg in at most 5 tickets. Chance = 50% FanDuel no-vig price + 50% ESPN game-log hit rate (this season, plus last season's final 20 games at 40% weight, shrunk toward FanDuel when few games), then small adjustments: opponent points allowed (±3 pts max), NBA minutes trend, teammates out. Players listed Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Day-To-Day by ESPN are excluded. Only legs with est. chance ≥60% and not worse than FanDuel's own price by >2 pts.
